scripts.setup: uv sync --dev && cd frontend && pnpm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend -c cyan,yellow "pnpm run backend" "pnpm run frontend"
scripts.openapi: uv run python -m scripts.openapi && pnpm --dir docs run generate:api && pnpm --dir frontend run types:generate
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run front:check
scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:exe
scripts.radon:mi: uv run radon mi main.py backend/ -s
scripts.radon:cc: uv run radon cc main.py backend/ -s -a && uv run radon cc main.py backend/ -s -a -O cc.txt
scripts.radon: uv run radon cc main.py backend/ -s -a -j -O cc.json && uv run radon mi main.py backend/ -s -j -O mi.json && uv run radon hal main.py backend/ -j -O hal.json
scripts.profile: uv run python -m cProfile -o cprofile.prof main.py && uv run snakeviz cprofile.prof
scripts.profile:line: cross-env LINE_PROFILE=1 uv run python main.py
scripts.clean: uv run python -c "from pathlib import Path; [f.unlink() for pattern in ['*.prof', '*.lprof', 'cc.json', 'mi.json', 'hal.json'] for f in Path('.').glob(pattern)]"
scripts.clean:build: uv run python -c "import shutil; [shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True) for d in ['backend/static', 'build', 'dist']]"
